name: cueclock
description: CueClock - cross-platform stage/event countdown timer with control panel, fullscreen display, and Companion integration

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w packages/server && npm run build -w packages/web
scripts.electron:dev: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w packages/server && npm run build -w packages/web && npm run build -w packages/electron && npm run start -w packages/electron
scripts.electron:build: npm run build && npm run build -w packages/electron && npm run dist -w packages/electron
